production.note: US model years. First: the 2023 Nissan Z was 'scheduled to go on sale at Nissan dealers nationwide in summer 2022'. Still on sale: Nissan's 2027 Z press kit says 'The 2027 Nissan Z lineup, including the Z NISMO manual, is scheduled to arrive at Nissan dealerships in summer 2026' (nissan-us-2027-z-press-kit). The Z NISMO is a separate variant.

body.note: Inferred from Nissan's description of the two-seat Z sports car; sold only as a coupe.

configuration.note: 'VR30DDTT 3.0L V6 Twin Turbo engine, 24-valve DOHC V6'

fuel.note: Inferred from Nissan's description of a conventional twin-turbo V6; no hybrid system.

transmission.note: 'Standard 6-speed close-ratio manual transmission with EXEDY® high-performance clutch'; 'Available electronically controlled 9-speed automatic transmission with manual shift mode, launch control, Downshift Rev Matching'

powerHp.note: Sport and Performance, 2023 model year. Quotes: "400 @ 6,400 rpm" (specifications table) and "VR30DDTT 3.0L V6 Twin Turbo engine, 24-valve DOHC V6 rated at 400 horsepower @ 6,400 RPM". Unchanged through 2027: Sport and Performance "400 @ 6,400 rpm" (nissan-us-2027-z-press-kit). The Z NISMO (420 hp) is a separate record.

weightLb.note: Sport grade (the base car), 6-speed manual, 2023 model year. Quote (curb weight table, lbs): Sport 6MT "Front 1991, Rear 1495, Total 3486". Same table: Sport 9AT 3,549; Performance 6MT 3,536, 9AT 3,602. The 2027 kit gives the same Sport 6MT total, 3,486 lb (nissan-us-2027-z-press-kit).
